jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Wealth.com http://Wealth.com is the industry's leading advanced planning platform. Trusted by many of the largest names in global finance, Wealth.com http://Wealth.com combines proprietary AI with deep technical expertise to serve the needs of clients across the wealth spectrum. The company has been widely recognized for innovation and leadership, winning Top Estate Planning Technology and Top Estate Planning Implementation at the 2025 WealthManagement.com http://WealthManagement.com Industry Awards, being named the 2024 Best Technology Provider in the Trust category, and earning #1 in estate planning market share in the 2025 Kitces AdvisorTech Study.



Our team is fundamental to our standing as the leading wealth planning platform. We cultivate a collaborative and supportive environment, fostering innovation and making Wealth.com http://Wealth.com a truly enjoyable workplace. Wealth.com http://Wealth.com is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work for 2025.



The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team, reporting directly to the Director of Product Marketing. Product Marketing at Wealth.com http://Wealth.com sits within Product (not Marketing), and owns go-to-market strategy, positioning and messaging, sales enablement, lifecycle marketing, and product launches across our platform.



In this role, you'll focus on our enterprise segment: the large institutions, RIAs, and wealth management firms that represent our most strategic clients. You'll own positioning and go-to-market strategy for this segment, lead launch execution for new features and products, and act as the connective tissue between Product, Sales, and Customer Success to make sure our enterprise clients understand and adopt what we build.



This is a hands-on role. You'll be expected to execute (not just strategize) across email campaigns, launch assets, sales enablement content, and competitive positioning, while increasingly leveraging AI tools to move faster and do more with a lean team.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Wealth.com http://Wealth.com's product suite, with a growing focus on our enterprise segment as you ramp into the role

 - Lead end-to-end product launches from positioning and messaging to internal enablement and external communications

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure new features and products land clearly with enterprise clients and drive adoption

 - Build and execute lifecycle and email marketing campaigns that support activation, adoption, and retention across the client journey

 - Develop and maintain sales enablement assets (competitive battlecards, talk tracks, and collateral) that help our sales and CS teams win and grow enterprise accounts

 - Conduct competitive analysis and voice-of-customer research to sharpen positioning and inform roadmap and GTM decisions

 - Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, content development, and campaign execution, continuously looking for ways to do more with a lean team

 - Represent the voice of the enterprise customer internally, ensuring their needs and feedback shape both product and go-to-market strategy



Qualifications

 - 5+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally within B2B SaaS

 - Experience developing differentiated positioning and messaging frameworks, and translating complex product functionality into clear, compelling narratives for different audiences

 - Hands-on email marketing execution experience, building, testing, and optimizing campaigns in platforms like Customer.io http://Customer.io, HubSpot, or similar

 - Data-driven approach to the role: comfortable defining and tracking launch effectiveness, feature adoption, and other GTM metrics, and using that data to inform decisions

 - Demonstrated comfort using AI tools to work faster and more effectively, for research, content creation, competitive analysis, or campaign execution

 - Experience building sales enablement content (battlecards, talk tracks, one-pagers) that sales teams actually use

 - Comfortable owning work end-to-end, from strategy through hands-on execution, managing multiple concurrent launches and competing deadlines in a lean, fast-moving team



Preferred Qualifications

 - B2B SaaS product marketing experience

 - Experience conducting customer or market research, including win/loss analysis, customer interviews, or voice-of-customer synthesis, to inform positioning and roadmap decisions

 - Experience marketing in a regulated industry, with comfort navigating compliance and legal review processes

 - Customer marketing experience, building case studies, testimonials, or customer stories to support sales

 - Experience with platforms such as Customer.io http://Customer.io, Userpilot, and data/analytics platforms (e.g., Omni)

 - Graphic design skills or experience (Figma, Canva, or similar)

 - Experience in financial services, wealth management, or estate planning is a significant plus



Benefits & Perks

 - Competitive salary.

 - Hybrid work arrangement in New York City, San Francisco, or Phoenix (3x a week)

 - Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance options, with low-cost premium structures that demonstrate our commitment to offering great value to our employees.

 - 100% company-paid basic life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance.

 - 100% paid parental leave upon eligibility.

 - Company equity managed through Carta.

 - 401k with match and 100% vesting upon hire.

 - Flexible PTO in an environment where taking time off to relax or recharge is supported and encouraged.

 - Take time off for holidays—and yes, your birthday counts too. Celebrate, relax, and recharge without thinking twice.

 - Free estate planning for life!



Wealth is an equal opportunity employer and encourages people from all backgrounds to apply. Should you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.location: Hybrid, New York, Tempe, San Francisco
jobs.description:
About Us

Wealth.com http://Wealth.com is the industry's leading advanced planning platform. Trusted by many of the largest names in global finance, Wealth.com http://Wealth.com combines proprietary AI with deep technical expertise to serve the needs of clients across the wealth spectrum. The company has been widely recognized for innovation and leadership, winning Top Estate Planning Technology and Top Estate Planning Implementation at the 2025 WealthManagement.com http://WealthManagement.com Industry Awards, being named the 2024 Best Technology Provider in the Trust category, and earning #1 in estate planning market share in the 2025 Kitces AdvisorTech Study.

 

Our team is fundamental to our standing as the leading wealth planning platform. We cultivate a collaborative and supportive environment, fostering innovation and making Wealth.com http://Wealth.com a truly enjoyable workplace. Wealth.com http://Wealth.com is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work for 2025.

 

The Opportunity

Wealth's mission is to deliver a revolutionized financial and estate management platform for the modern world. We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to serve as a core product leader across our platform ecosystem. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role where you will own the end-to-end strategy, roadmap, and execution for key parts of the Wealth.com http://Wealth.com experience.

As a Staff PM, you will bridge the gap between complex financial and legal workflows, core platform architecture, and direct enterprise advisory feedback. You will operate on the front lines with financial advisors, enterprise leadership, and legal end-users, transforming real-world customer friction points into scalable, elegant product solutions.



Key Responsibilities

 - Direct Customer Discovery & Advisory: Lead ongoing customer discovery calls, interviews, and co-design sessions with enterprise wealth management clients, advisors, and legal staff to uncover friction points and validate platform workflows.

 - Customer Advisory Boards & Beta Management: Establish and run beta testing programs and customer advisory loops for major feature releases, engaging directly with key accounts to evaluate workflow efficiency, adoption, and user delight.

 - Customer-Facing Evangelism & Demos: Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to join key client meetings, present product roadmaps, lead live capability demos, and act as the product voice of Wealth.com http://Wealth.com to external stakeholders.

 - Strategic Vision & Roadmap Execution: Drive multi-quarter product strategy and execution across your domain, prioritizing solutions that deliver outsized value for advisors while balancing technical feasibility, business needs, and platform scalability.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, product design, and legal domain experts to translate customer feedback into crisp functional requirements, system architectures, and intuitive user experiences.

 - Market & Competitive Intelligence: Analyze market shifts, regulatory trends, and user adoption data to continuously position Wealth.com http://Wealth.com as the undisputed leader in estate planning technology.

 - Product Evangelism: Serve as an internal and external champion for your product surface, aligning executive leadership, sales, marketing, and enterprise partners.



Qualifications

 - 10+ years of product management experience (or equivalent founder/technical leadership experience), with a proven track record of scaling core SaaS platform products from zero-to-one and beyond in high-growth environments.

 - Deep Customer-Facing Experience: Demonstrated background leading user discovery sessions, participating in enterprise client conversations, running customer advisory boards, and managing co-development cycles with external partners.

 - Product & Platform Architecture Ownership: Strong experience defining end-to-end product requirements, managing complex system integrations, and partnering with engineering teams to build resilient, scalable enterprise software.

 - Customer Empathy & Translation: Ability to translate complex platform infrastructure and domain logic into clear, ROI-focused language for non-technical advisory clients, while conversely translating messy customer requests into structured technical specs.

 - Fast-Paced Execution: Thrives in high-growth, fast-evolving environments with high autonomy, extreme ownership, and a bias toward action.

 - Data-Informed Decision Making: Proven ability to marry qualitative customer feedback with quantitative usage metrics, funnel analytics, and business outcomes.

 - A “Founder” Mentality: Highly proactive, resourceful, and passionate about solving unaddressed, complex real-world problems.

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



Benefits & Perks

 - Competitive salary.

 - Hybrid work arrangement in New York City (3x a week)

 - Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance options, with low-cost premium structures that demonstrate our commitment to offering great value to our employees.

 - 100% company-paid basic life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance.

 - 100% paid parental leave upon eligibility.

 - Company equity managed through Carta.

 - 401k with match and 100% vesting upon hire.

 - Flexible PTO in an environment where taking time off to relax or recharge is supported and encouraged.

 - Take time off for holidays—and yes, your birthday counts too. Celebrate, relax, and recharge without thinking twice.

 - Free estate planning for life!

 

Wealth is an equal opportunity employer and encourages people from all backgrounds to apply. Should you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
